title: Chloroform-Methanol Protein Extraction for Gram-negative Bacteria
author: Jennifer Gin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfx6jpre
materials: Chemicals to prepare: • Prepare 100 millimolar (mM), Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) solution by dissolving 28.7 mg, TCEP in 1 mL, 100mM Ammonium Bicarbonate • Prepare 200 millimolar (mM), Iodoacetamide (IAA) solution by dissolving 36.8 mg, Iodoacetamide in 1 mL, 100mM Ammonium Bicarbonate •Prepare 1 mg/mL, Trypsin by adding 1 mL, 1mM HCl to 1 mg, Trypsin Store TCEP, IAA, and Trypsin in -20C. IAA is light sensitive. Store in amber tube (Fisher Scientific, Cat.#05-402-31).
Carefully pipet out clear liquid sample into plastic autosampler vials (ThermoFisherScientific, Cat.#03-060-016) or a 96-well plate (BIO-RAD, Cat.#HSP9601).

steps.title: Thaw cells on ice
steps.instruction: Place frozen cell pellets on ice until thawed; skip this step if cells are taken directly from active cultures.

steps.title: Transfer cell pellet to tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot 2–4 OD·mL of cells into 8‑strip PCR tubes (Axygen, Cat.#14‑222‑251) or a 96‑well PCR plate (ThermoFisher, Cat.#AB0600). A strip filled 30–40 % full corresponds to ~2–5 OD·mL.

steps.title: Add solvents and mix
steps.instruction: Add methanol, chloroform and water to each tube/well and vortex to mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL LC‑MS grade Methanol (VWR Scientific, Cat.#BJLC230‑2.5) and pipet to resuspend.
Add 20 µL Chloroform (Sigma‑Aldrich, Cat.#34854) and pipet/vortex; perform in a fume hood.
Add 60 µL LC‑MS grade Water (VWR Scientific, Cat.#BJLC365‑2.5) and pipet/vortex.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 25 °C for 1 minute.

steps.title: Remove aqueous layer
steps.instruction: Pipette off the top layer (Methanol + Water) without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Add methanol to pellet
steps.instruction: Add methanol to the protein pellet, breaking it up with the pipette tip, and ensure the solvent contacts the bottom of the tube/plate.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 25 °C for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Discard solvent and air‑dry
steps.instruction: Remove the remaining Methanol + Chloroform solvent, discard in appropriate halogenated‑solvent waste, then air‑dry the pellet for 5 minutes (do not exceed 45 minutes). Perform drying in a fume hood.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 60 µL of 100 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate prepared in 20 % Methanol. The suspension will appear cloudy.

steps.title: Store until quantitation
steps.instruction: Store the resuspended samples at –20 °C until ready for protein quantitation assay.

steps.title: Dilute samples ten‑fold
steps.instruction: Create a 10‑fold dilution by adding 5 µL of protein sample to 45 µL of water in the same tube or plate.

steps.title: Prepare assay plate
steps.instruction: In a Corning 96‑well black polystyrene microplate (Fisher Scientific, Cat.#07‑200‑590), add blanks, standards and diluted samples in duplicate.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL Water (blank) to each designated well.
Add 5 µL Pierce BSA Standard Pre‑Diluted Set (ThermoFisher, Cat.#23208) to each standard well.
Add 5 µL of each diluted protein sample (two replicates per sample).

steps.title: Incubate assay plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C for 4 hours to 16 hours.

steps.title: Add Reagent A
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL Bio‑Rad DC Protein Assay Reagent A (Cat.#500‑0113) to each well and wait 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Reagent B
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Bio‑Rad DC Protein Assay Reagent B (Cat.#500‑0114) to each well and wait 10 minutes.

steps.title: Read plate and calculate
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 280 nm using a microplate reader and calculate protein concentrations from the standard curve.

steps.title: Prepare digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Mix protein with TCEP, IAA and trypsin in 100 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (AMBIC) to achieve final concentrations of 2 µg/µL protein (50 µL total), 5 mM TCEP, 10 mM IAA, and 2 µL trypsin (1 mg/mL, 1:50 enzyme:protein ratio). Two volume options are provided; choose one based on available protein.

substeps.instruction: Option A (for 2.4 µg/µL protein): add 41.67 µL protein (2.4 µg/µL), 2.5 µL TCEP (100 mM), 2.5 µL IAA (200 mM), 2 µL trypsin (1 mg/mL), then add AMBIC up to 50 µL total volume.
Option B (for 2.4 µg/µL protein, lower trypsin): add 20.83 µL protein (2.4 µg/µL), 2.5 µL TCEP (100 mM), 2.5 µL IAA (200 mM), 1 µL trypsin (1 mg/mL), then add AMBIC up to 50 µL total volume.
If protein amount is limiting, set final protein concentration to 1 µg/µL and adjust volumes proportionally.

steps.title: Store digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Store the prepared digestion mixture at –20 °C until LC‑MS/MS analysis.

steps.title: Centrifuge digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Final dilution for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Dilute protein samples to 2.4 µg/µL in 100 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (AB); mix well before dilution.
